requested: Review the gain-only MuJoCo calibration rollout collection plan before bounded offline construction
preserved: Frozen Planner and Tracker, H=30, K=6 and first-action-only execution
Formal three-axis Stage 1 remains fail-closed for a gain-only smoke dataset
forbidden: Inject a fault by passing faulted actions into the collector-facing env.step boundary
Expose faulted executed actions as a training or deployment input
Run simulation, training, deployment, Git writes or policy-quality evaluation

review.scope: Independent plan, owner, lifecycle, persistence and proof-route review

source_edits.scope: Review ownership made no production or test edits

report_write.scope: Persist the READY plan dependency receipt
report_write.receipt: The user approved the gain mapping and requested one-shot implementation on 2026-08-20

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: G1 owns the action-execution transform, the collector owns history and raw persistence, and the script only composes public owners.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The collector receives an approved typed protocol and a public environment factory; no backend-private capability is exposed.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: The composition root depends on training APIs and owner modules; deterministic fault and persistence rules do not move into scripts.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Rows remain pending inside one episode and fixed Command, reset/drift discards the transaction, and publication is atomic.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The plan touches only the G1 action execution pinch point, one collection owner, its config, CLI, dataset admission and focused tests.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Offline module evidence, server simulator execution, formal Stage 1 and policy quality remain explicitly separate.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: The plan requires RED/GREEN semantic samples for fault order, real-history warmup, episode rollback, raw identity, atomic persistence and dataset sealing.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Raw rows bind State/nominal Action histories, Planner Intent, K=6 chunk, gain label, diagnostic executed Action, rollout/split/seed and exact source/protocol/task identities.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Collection constructs no optimizer, snapshots the frozen source Planner-IDM, and must prove its parameters are unchanged after collection.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Typed raw admission precedes existing dataset sealing; corrupted identities and partial writes fail closed before a training artifact exists.

residual_risks: READY authorizes bounded offline construction only and does not prove MuJoCo runtime compatibility, rollout stability, Stage 1 training or calibration efficacy.
